title: US removes tariffs upon cement imported from Canada
content:
US: The US government has removed tariffs upon cement imported from Canada. The announcement was made in a series of Presidential Proclamations released on 8 September 2026 and which took effect on 15 September 2026. A 50% tariff on a wide range of goods from Canada, including cement, was imposed in July 2026 with enactment from mid-August 2026.
